name: should ignore another payment, a URL without a status, and the bank pages
fullName: parseMoyasar3dsCallback should ignore another payment, a URL without a status, and the bank pages
description:
3-D Secure completion: the sheet hands control back the moment Moyasar's
callback redirect is seen, keeps a waiting screen up while the payment is
confirmed, and never fails a payment just because the status endpoint cannot
see it (the backend answers 404 for a new booking's payment until confirmed).
